metadata.notice: Form structure is described for discussion. No live Kobo data, person-level data, submitted answers, or approved scoring are supplied.

forms.title: School Assessment
forms.purpose: Assess school conditions and resource needs using eight criteria.
notes: Includes condition and WASH counts, equipment and material repeat inventories, enrollment, governance, community involvement, school fees and external support.
Some required fields may create respondent burden; field testing is pending.
Do not publish weighted scores without approval of the underlying rubric.

forms.title: School Evaluation
forms.purpose: Review the 14 VF conditions across governance/compliance, monitoring/protection and mission integration.
forms.status: Sample / not approved — not a compliance determination
notes: The sample workbook itself explicitly says its responses do not establish compliance.
Wording, thresholds, evidence access, country adaptation and safeguard permissions require approval.
Do not combine its conditions with School Assessment ratings to invent an overall grade.
